summary: Import-time auto-launch of opaque helper binary from user-writable path with filesystem watcher
details: On require('native-runner'), index.js first loads the sibling dependency img-to-native, then unconditionally auto-launches an executable at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\NodeRuntime\node_runtime_helper.exe detached, with hidden window and stdio ignored. If the binary is not present, the module creates the directory and installs an fs.watch that spawns whatever appears at that path as soon as it is written. The helper binary is not shipped in this package and the auto-launch path and watcher are not disclosed in the README, which advertises only runBinary/runDetached APIs. The sibling dependency img-to-native is declared as a hard dependency but is never referenced by any code in this package after the initial require, matching a split-loader pattern where the sibling stages a binary that this package executes. Any component with write access to the LOCALAPPDATA helper path — including the transitive dependency loaded moments earlier — obtains code execution on the installer's host with no action beyond require().

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
